description: Fix log-server multi-server support and add detailed logging
changes: Updated log-server to use serverConfig for fetching logs
Added detailed logging to trace which server is used for log streaming
Removed global isConnected() check that broke multi-server
features: Log streaming now works correctly with multiple servers
Enhanced logging shows server info for each log operation
fixes: Log server showing 'No such container' error when using multiple servers
Logs being fetched from wrong server in multi-server setup
Continuous connection errors in log streaming
notes: Critical fix for log-server multi-server functionality - logs now stream from correct server
